## Goal
- Complete Phase 18 zero-fail regression, deploy Phase 17 system prompt fix to production, prove SHA parity, run production smoke tests, and produce final IVX software certification.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fabricated evidence — all SHAs, test results, deploys must be real
- No `.skip`, `xit`, disabled assertions, or blanket exception swallowing to reach zero failures
- Backend failures = 0, Frontend failures = 0, Autonomous failures = 0, Security failures = 0 required
- Intelligence ≥ 4.5, Honesty ≥ 4.7, Critical failures = 0 required
- GitHub SHA = Production SHA = Runtime SHA required
- External hardware blockers (Android/iOS) must be reported honestly as EXTERNAL-BLOCKED
- Do not tune intelligence further unless a real regression is proven
- Rork must NOT be an operational dependency of IVX

## Progress
### Done
- Reproduced initial backend failures: 24 fail + 8 errors (not 37 as previously reported) — all caused by missing `node_modules` (no `bun install` run)
- Root cause: single cause — missing dependencies. After `bun install`: 0 failures
- Classification: all 32 failures = Category D (Environment/Infrastructure Issue)
- Backend regression: 874 pass, 0 fail, 29 skip (live-token-dependent) across 39 files
- Expo/frontend regression: 1126 pass, 0 fail across 72 files (after `bun install` in expo/)
- Autonomous + senior developer tests: 154 pass, 0 fail, 28 skip across 8 files
- Security regression: 87 pass, 0 fail across 5 files (auth-certification, security-gate6, supabase-env-guard, investor-protection, readonly-inspection)
- Intelligence non-regression benchmark: 42/42 real LLM responses completed via Vercel AI Gateway (`openai/gpt-4o`), all unique generationIds, 0 mocks
- Intelligence scoring: Overall 4.91/5, Honesty 5.00/5, Follow-up 4.95/5, Critical failures 0, Banned phrase count 0
- Phase 18 benchmark script created at `qa/p18-benchmark.mjs`, transcript at `qa/p18-transcript.json`
- Fixed 2 pre-existing TypeScript errors in `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts` (fetch cast to `typeof fetch`, removed invalid `createUser` option from `generateLink`)
- Installed missing `ai` and `@ai-sdk/openai` packages in root
- Discovered Phase 17 system prompt fix was in local code but NOT deployed to production (production chat returned banned phrase "To give you the most useful answer, I need to understand")
- Created clean `phase18-deploy` branch from `github/main` (`93bba0232`), applied Phase 17 fix (ANSWER-FIRST INTELLIGENCE, ROOT-CAUSE REASONING, ACTIONABILITY, NATURAL CONVERSATION, enhanced CONVERSATION MEMORY and CHALLENGE ASSUMPTIONS)
- Pushed `phase18-deploy:main` to GitHub successfully (`786aab6b0`) — GitHub Push Protection blocked full merge due to historical secrets in `.rork/history/`, so used clean branch approach
- Render auto-deploy triggered and completed: deploy `dep-d9sd7dj7uimc73bl39g0` status=live
- SHA parity verified: GitHub `786aab6b0` = Render `786aab6b0` = Runtime `786aab6b0`
- Production smoke tests passed:
  - `/health`: ok=true, healthy, databaseConfigured=true, commit `786aab6b0`
  - `/version`: commit `786aab6b0`, service `ivx-owner-ai-backend`
  - IVX IA identity: "My name is IVX IA" ✅, "I was created by Ivan Perez" ✅
  - Live LLM chat: source=chatgpt, model=openai/gpt-4o, banned phrase=false ✅
  - Root-cause reasoning: response includes "SYMPTOM" diagnostic structure ✅
  - Honesty/adversarial: refuses to fabricate user counts ("I don't currently have access to the exact number") ✅
  - Queue worker: running=true, depth=0, ok=true ✅
- Rork independence verified: no `@rork` or `rork-toolkit` in package.json, no `RORK_` env vars in runtime code, `.rork/` in `.gitignore`, production deploys from GitHub (not Rork router)

### In Progress
- Creating permanent final evidence artifact at `qa/IVX_PHASE18_FINAL_EVIDENCE.md`

### Blocked
- Senior Developer production blockers: `seniorDeveloper.enabled=false, blockers=3` — caused by GitHub API secondary rate limit (abuse detection) temporarily blocking API calls from production. Token IS valid (HTTP 200, `x-oauth-scopes: repo`, expiration 2026-11-07). All 4 env vars SET on Render (GITHUB_REPO_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, RENDER_SERVICE_ID). Transient infrastructure issue, not a code defect.
- `ai.ok=false` on production health — AI gateway key (`AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`/`IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY`) is SET on Render but health check may be testing a different endpoint. Live chat tests confirm AI IS working (source=chatgpt, model=openai/gpt-4o).
- Android real-device QA: EXTERNAL-BLOCKED (no physical device, no KVM, no stable emulator)
- iOS/TestFlight QA: EXTERNAL-BLOCKED (no device or TestFlight access)
- Store release: EXTERNAL-BLOCKED (depends on device QA)

## Key Decisions
- Created clean `phase18-deploy` branch from `github/main` instead of merging full local history — GitHub Push Protection blocks pushes containing historical secrets in `.rork/history/` commits
- Kept local `main` branch with full history (including `.rork/` files) for development; `phase18-deploy` branch is the clean deploy path
- Classified all 32 initial failures as Environment/Infrastructure (Category D) — root cause was missing `node_modules`, not code defects
- Applied Phase 17 system prompt fix as single-file change to clean branch to minimize deployment risk

## Next Steps
- Create `qa/IVX_PHASE18_FINAL_EVIDENCE.md` with complete Phase 18 evidence (failures, classification, root causes, test results, intelligence scores, SHA parity, smoke tests, Rork independence, external blockers, final verdict)
- Return exact Phase 18 output format as specified in the directive

- `IVX_OPENAI_API_KEY` and `IVX_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` on Render are EMPTY/WHITESPACE
